title: Dead Reckoning Tool Contract
description: A tool's declaration of how it behaves when its backend is unavailable, its side-effect class, its consequence level, and the preconditions that must hold for deferred execution. Validated at registry startup.

description.description: Shown to the model in the manifest. One sentence.

backend.description: Dependency name whose health governs availability. Null means the tool is always local and never QUEUED or UNAVAILABLE.

offline_policy.description: LOCAL: run the local substitute. QUEUE: record intent to the outbox. FAIL: return UNAVAILABLE; conclusions depending on it must abstain.

approval.description: Minimum approval policy. The identity authority table may tighten it at call or drain time; it can never loosen it.

preconditions.description: For QUEUE tools. Each names a registered checker and maps call args to checker args.

idempotency_key.description: Template over call args, e.g. 'dispatch:{ticket_id}'. Null means sha256(name + canonical(args)).

expiry_s.description: For QUEUE tools: seconds a deferred intent remains valid. Null means no expiry (discouraged).

staleness_budget_s.description: For LOCAL tools: maximum acceptable age of local data before it is reported LOCAL_STALE.

fail_when_stale.description: For LOCAL tools: treat stale data as UNAVAILABLE instead of LOCAL_STALE.

prefer_local_when_slow.description: Use the local substitute when the backend is SLOW rather than waiting.

slow_timeout_s.description: Extended timeout used when backend is SLOW and the live path is taken.

canary.description: How to actively probe the backend. Null means passive observation only.

args_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments; passed to the model for native tool calling and used to validate JSON-protocol calls.

hydrate.description: How to fill this tool's rows in the local store while its backend is reachable. Null means rows arrive by the path named in local_source instead. Must declare subject_types with arg_from_subject, or static_args, or both.

subject_types.description: Subject type prefixes this tool serves, for example 'ticket' or 'feeder'. A working set entry whose identifier begins with a listed prefix is hydrated by this tool.

arg_from_subject.description: The single tool argument that receives the id component of a matching subject identifier. The id is passed as an opaque string; the runtime never parses inside it.

static_args.description: Fixed argument objects fetched once per pass regardless of the working set. Serves tools that take no subject, such as list_open_tickets with [{}], and tools keyed on something the working set does not name.

max_rows.description: Cap on stored rows for this tool. Once at the cap, rows whose subject is absent from the current working set are evicted oldest first; rows produced by static_args are evicted oldest first among themselves.

local_source.description: Names the non-fetch path by which this tool's rows arrive, for tools whose local data is entered locally and never fetched. Such rows are never evicted, because they cannot be refetched.

verify_supported.description: Tool implements verify(idempotency_key) -> executed|not_executed|unknown, used to reconcile EXECUTING entries found on restart.
